review.appReviewNotes:
Paste this text into App Store Connect > App Review Information > Notes.

DISTRIBUTION AND AUDIENCE
AliStore Staff is a limited employee resource for AliStore personnel and is intended for Unlisted App distribution. It supports AliStore's internal order processing, warehouse and service tasks, KPI, customer service, product intake and buyback workflows. It is not offered as a public multi-tenant subscription service and has no public self-service registration.

DEMO ACCOUNT
Use the username and matching credential entered in the Demo Account fields. Enter them exactly in the two Russian-labelled fields on the sign-in screen, then tap the sign-in button. The review path has no SMS or one-time-code step. The account must be active and two-factor authentication must be disabled before resubmission. No credential is included in these notes or in repository metadata.

REVIEW DATA
The owner must verify the account and each representative workflow immediately before resubmission. These notes do not claim that sample orders, tasks, customers or other review objects have been seeded until that gate passes.

WHAT TO EXPECT
Access is role-based and authorized by the AliStore server. Face ID is optional and only unlocks an existing signed-in session. The app does not track users and its privacy manifest declares NSPrivacyTracking=false.

UNLISTED REQUEST
An Unlisted App distribution request must be submitted for this app. Please evaluate this submission for that limited employee audience rather than for public App Store discovery.

CONTACT
Support: https://ali.kg/support.

ru-KG.description: AliStore Staff — операционное ERP-приложение для розничных магазинов электроники. Персонал магазина обрабатывает заказы, выполняет складские и сервисные задачи, отслеживает KPI, обслуживает клиентов, принимает товары и ведёт операции скупки по регламентам магазина. Доступ ролевой: магазин выдаёт учётные записи своим сотрудникам.
